amendments.detail: mac-rail-b-preapproval.sh line 90 invoked railb_assert_no_runtime_source, which the library no longer defined after the boundary function was renamed. bash -n could not detect it.

The verifier used a blanket 'any PASS means untruthful' predicate. A truthful dry run legitimately reports PASS for gates that genuinely execute (host attestation, branch semantics, executable boundary), so the predicate produced a false negative.
